codeBeacon.untrustedWorkspaces.descripti: In Restricted Mode the search URL, the trailing-space pattern and the message exclusion patterns fall back to their user-level values.
codeBeacon.command.searchForProblem: Search for Problem on Current Line
codeBeacon.command.copyProblemMessage: Copy Problem Message on Current Line
codeBeacon.enabled.description: Master switch. Turns every decoration and the status bar item on or off.
codeBeacon.diagnosticsEnabled.descriptio: Show diagnostics (errors, warnings, info, hints) inline at the end of the line.
codeBeacon.trailingSpacesEnabled.descrip: Highlight trailing spaces while editing. When off, trailing spaces can still be removed with the commands.
codeBeacon.excludePatterns.description: Glob patterns matched against the absolute file path. Matching files get no diagnostics decorations and no trailing-space highlighting, e.g. `**/*.md` or `**/node_modules/**`.
codeBeacon.excludeLanguages.description: Language identifiers to skip for both features, e.g. `markdown`, `plaintext`. Case-sensitive.
codeBeacon.excludeSchemes.description: Document schemes to skip for both features. Add `untitled` to skip unsaved new files. `git` and `vscode-scm` are always skipped.
codeBeacon.delay.description: Milliseconds to wait after a change before redrawing (debounce). Applies to diagnostics and trailing spaces.
codeBeacon.statusBarEnabled.description: Show a status bar item with the number of errors, warnings, info and lines with trailing spaces. Click opens the Problems view.
codeBeacon.statusBarAlignment.descriptio: Which side of the status bar the item appears on.
codeBeacon.statusBarPriority.description: Ordering weight of the status bar item. Higher values appear further to the left.
codeBeacon.statusBarScope.description: Which diagnostics to count. Trailing spaces are always counted for the active editor only.
codeBeacon.diagnosticLevels.description: Severities to show inline and count in the status bar.
codeBeacon.followCursor.description: Which problems to show inline relative to the cursor.
codeBeacon.followCursor.allLinesExceptAc: Every line except the cursor line
codeBeacon.followCursor.closestProblem: Only the problem closest to the cursor
codeBeacon.messageTemplate.description: Template for the inline message. Variables: `$message`, `$count` (number of problems on the line, shown only when more than one), `$severity` (symbol from `#codeBeacon.severityText#`), `$source`, `$code`. An empty template keeps the line background but shows no text.
codeBeacon.messageMaxChars.description: Truncate inline messages longer than this many characters. 0 means no limit.
codeBeacon.maxInlineMessages.description: Maximum number of inline messages per document, to keep huge files responsive. 0 means no limit.
codeBeacon.messageBackgroundMode.descrip: Where the severity background color is painted.
codeBeacon.severityText.description: Symbols that `$severity` expands to, in the order error, warning, info, hint. They are drawn in the severity's foreground color.
codeBeacon.margin.description: CSS margin between the end of the code and the inline message, e.g. `4ch` or `1em`.
codeBeacon.fontSize.description: CSS font size of the inline message, e.g. `12px` or `0.9em`. Empty follows the editor.
codeBeacon.fontWeight.description: Font weight of the inline message.
codeBeacon.fontStyleItalic.description: Render the inline message in italics.
codeBeacon.problemRangeDecorationEnabled: Also paint the exact range of each problem (not just the line) with the severity's range background color.
codeBeacon.excludeByMessage.description: Regular expressions. Problems whose message matches any of them are hidden, e.g. `^Unused variable`.
codeBeacon.excludeBySource.description: Problem sources to hide. `eslint` hides everything from that source; `eslint(no-unused-vars)` hides only that rule.
codeBeacon.searchForProblemQuery.descrip: URL opened by the search command. `$message` is replaced with the encoded problem message. Only `http://` and `https://` URLs are opened. User-level setting only.
codeBeacon.alignMessage.description: Align inline messages to a fixed column. `start`: column where the message begins (0 = right after the code). `end`: column where the message ends (used when `start` is 0). `minimumMargin`: gap in characters when the code is longer than the column. `padding`: [left, right] padding in characters. `useFixedPosition`: false ignores `start`/`end` and only applies the padding.
codeBeacon.gutterIconsEnabled.descriptio: Show a severity icon in the gutter next to the line number. Gutter icons ignore `#codeBeacon.followCursor#`.
codeBeacon.gutterEmoji.description: Emoji per severity used when the icon set is `emoji`.
codeBeacon.gutterIconColors.description: Icon color per severity for the `default`, `circle` and `letter` icon sets.
codeBeacon.onSave.description: Update diagnostics decorations only when a document is saved, instead of live.
codeBeacon.onSaveTimeout.description: In on-save mode, how many milliseconds the decorations stay visible after saving.
codeBeacon.trailingSpacesRegexp.descript: Regular expression that matches trailing whitespace at the end of a line. The default `[ \t]+` matches spaces and tabs.
codeBeacon.trailingSpacesHighlightCurren: Also highlight trailing spaces on the line the cursor is on. Turn off to avoid flashing while typing.
codeBeacon.trimIncludeEmptyLines.descrip: When removing, also clear lines that consist only of whitespace. Off keeps those lines untouched.
codeBeacon.trimModifiedLinesOnly.descrip: Only remove trailing spaces on lines changed since the file was opened or last saved. Highlighting still covers the whole file. Use `Remove Trailing Spaces (Whole File)` to clean everything.
codeBeacon.trailingSpacesHighlightOnly.d: Highlight only, never remove automatically. Turn off to remove trailing spaces on save (respecting `#codeBeacon.trimIncludeEmptyLines#` and `#codeBeacon.trimModifiedLinesOnly#`). The commands work either way.
codeBeacon.trimStatusBarMessage.descript: Show a short status bar message after trailing spaces were removed.
codeBeacon.trailingSpacesBackgroundColor: Background color of highlighted trailing spaces (CSS color).
codeBeacon.trailingSpacesBorderColor.des: Border color of highlighted trailing spaces (CSS color).
codeBeacon.color.errorMessageBackground: Background behind the inline error message.
codeBeacon.color.errorRangeBackground: Background of the exact error range.
codeBeacon.color.errorForeground: Text color of the inline error message.
codeBeacon.color.warningMessageBackgroun: Background behind the inline warning message.
codeBeacon.color.warningRangeBackground: Background of the exact warning range.
codeBeacon.color.warningForeground: Text color of the inline warning message.
codeBeacon.color.infoMessageBackground: Background behind the inline info message.
codeBeacon.color.infoRangeBackground: Background of the exact info range.
codeBeacon.color.infoForeground: Text color of the inline info message.
codeBeacon.color.hintMessageBackground: Background behind the inline hint message.
codeBeacon.color.hintRangeBackground: Background of the exact hint range.
codeBeacon.color.hintForeground: Text color of the inline hint message.
